en.name: Suya spice (yaji)
en.summary: Suya spice keeps about 6 months in an airtight jar in a cool, dark cupboard — the standard figure for a ground spice blend. A large batch is better kept sealed in the fridge, where a working limit of about 1 year is reasonable; that refrigerated figure is our own reading rather than a published one.
en.pantry: 6 months airtight, cool, dark and dry — but expect the shorter end of that. Yaji is not really a spice blend at all: its bulk is defatted or roasted groundnut, and that fat goes rancid long before the chilli fades. The first sign is a stale, cardboardy taste rather than a smell, so taste a pinch before you rub a whole piece of meat with it. Keep the jar off the shelf above the hob, where heat does the damage fastest.
en.fridge: A working limit of about 1 year, sealed. Anything carrying nut oil keeps better cold, though it is only worth the fridge space for a large batch you cannot get through in a season. Seal the jar against fridge odours and condensation, and let it come up to room temperature before you open it so it does not take on moisture.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline exists for suya spice. Freezing would protect the groundnut oil in the same way refrigeration does, but the practical cost is condensation: a powder that is repeatedly taken out of the freezer cakes into lumps. If you have far more than a year's worth, freeze it in small sealed portions and take out one at a time rather than opening the same bag over and over.
spoilage: A stale, cardboard or crayon taste — rancid groundnut, and the usual failure.
Chilli red faded to a dull brown and no heat on the tongue.
Hard cakes or damp clumps from a wet spoon or a humid cupboard.
Any visible mould, which means moisture got in and the jar goes in the bin.
tips: Taste a pinch before using it; rancid groundnut shows up on the tongue before the nose.
Never return rub that has touched raw meat to the jar — tip out what you need onto a plate.
Keep the jar away from the hob; heat is what ages the nut oil.
Buy or make small batches rather than one big tub.

faq.q: How long does suya spice last?
faq.a: About 6 months airtight in a cool, dark cupboard. Sealed in the fridge, roughly 1 year is a reasonable working limit, though that figure is a judgement rather than a published one.

faq.q: Why does suya spice go off faster than other spice mixes?
faq.a: Because most of it is groundnut. The nut oil turns rancid long before the chilli or the ginger fade, and it tastes stale and cardboardy when it does.

faq.q: Can you reuse suya rub that has touched raw meat?
faq.a: No. Rub that has contacted raw meat is contaminated and must be thrown away, never tipped back into the jar.

zh.name: 蘇亞香料
zh.summary: 蘇亞香料裝密封罐、放在陰涼避光的櫃子裡大約可放 6 個月，這是研磨香料粉的一般標準。量大的話密封冷藏比較好，抓 1 年是合理的工作上限；不過冷藏這個數字是我們自己的判斷，不是公布的數據。
zh.pantry: 密封、陰涼、避光、乾燥，6 個月——而且要往短的那端想。yaji 其實稱不上是純香料粉：它的主體是脫脂或烘過的花生，而那些油脂會在辣椒褪色之前就先油耗。最早出現的徵兆是味道，不是氣味：嚐起來變得呆板、像紙板，所以整塊肉抹下去之前先捏一點試味。罐子不要放在爐火上方的層架，高溫最傷它。
zh.fridge: 密封冷藏，抓 1 年左右的工作上限。帶堅果油脂的東西冷藏比較耐放；不過只有一季內用不完的大批量，才值得占這個冰箱位子。罐子要密封好，擋住冰箱的雜味和水氣，而且回到室溫再開蓋，才不會受潮。
zh.freezer: 蘇亞香料沒有冷凍期限可循。冷凍對花生油脂的保護和冷藏是同一回事，但代價很實際：粉類反覆進出冷凍會結塊。如果真的多到一年用不完，就分成小份密封冷凍，要用才拿一份出來，不要一直開同一包。
spoilage: 嚐起來呆板、像紙板或蠟筆味——花生油耗了，這是最常見的結局。
辣椒的紅褪成暗褐色，入口也不辣了。
沾到濕湯匙或櫃子太潮而結成硬塊、濕塊。
看得到霉就整罐丟掉，那表示水氣已經進去了。
tips: 用之前先捏一點嚐味；花生油耗在舌頭上比在鼻子裡更早現形。
碰過生肉的香料絕對不能倒回罐子——要用多少先倒到盤子上。
罐子遠離爐火，高溫是讓堅果油脂老化的主因。
少量多次地買或做，不要一次配一大桶。

faq.a: 密封放陰涼避光處大約 6 個月。密封冷藏的話，抓 1 年是合理的上限，但這個數字是判斷，不是公布的數據。

faq.q: 蘇亞香料為什麼比別的綜合香料容易壞？
faq.a: 因為它大部分是花生。堅果油脂會在辣椒或薑褪味之前就先油耗，一耗掉就是那股呆板的紙板味。

faq.q: 抹過生肉的蘇亞香料還能再用嗎？
faq.a: 不行。碰過生肉的香料已經污染了，必須丟掉，絕對不要倒回罐子裡。
